claim: A filled count sheet's line is sent through the per-item count route (ADR 0078's one writer) as a line of its stock-take, on its shelf, aged from the shelf's written 'Counted at' so the F-249/F-880 overtaken rule refuses a shelf that moved; its key is made from what the sheet says, so the same sheet loaded twice replays. Nothing in the sheet module calls the database itself. Killed by dropping sessionId, the age, or the content key, or by adding an RPC or a random key.

'n'}\`\" in s and \".rpc(\" not in s and \"randomUUID\" not in s else 1)"

claim: A blank on a count sheet is not counted, never read as 0: a shelf is said done from a sheet only when every item the books list there has a number and every line landed, and the done posts no zeros of its own. Killed by reading a blank as 0, closing a shelf with an item unnumbered, or sending zeroItemIds.

claim: The count sheet is blind (count, shelf, item and their codes, then blank Full bottles, Open (tenths) and Counted at; never the books' figure or a price), and the review page offers it only to an owner or a manager on a count that was not stopped (ADR 0335 section 3).
